player_prompt.intro:
Tadakkest {color} di iri n Breakthrough. Tadakkest {direction} ɣef tablɣalt {board_size}x{board_size}.
Di tawmest-ik, tzemreḍ ad tesleḍ tifirɣa tisent taɣbalut neɣ taɣbalut s azɣar.
Tifirɣa tzemreḍ ad tesleḍ s azɣar kan ma yella tifirɣa n imɣazen, dɣa kan ad tesleḍ ɣer takat n imɣazen s azɣar.
Mi tzemreḍ ad tesleḍ ɣer takat n imɣazen, tzemreḍ ad tesnaḍ tifirɣa n imɣazen, dɣa tifirɣa n imɣazen tzemreḍ ad tettwakkes ɣef tablɣalt.
Seqdec notation UCI-like di tɣawsiwin, amedya [a2a3] ad tesleḍ ɣef a2 ɣer a3.
* 'a' yella di tɣawsiwin tazelmaṭ, '1' yella di tɣawsiwin tazelmaṭ (ɣef leḥsab n Umellal).
* Tɣawsiwin n imɣazen yella di tɣawsiwin tisent (tɣawsiwin 8 ɣef tablɣalt 8x8). Tɣawsiwin n Umellal yella di tɣawsiwin tazelmaṭ (tɣawsiwin 1 ɣef tablɣalt 8x8).
Amezwaru yella tifirɣa-ines tzemreḍ ad yaweḍ ɣer tɣawsiwin n imɣazen, yella itxarreḍ. Ma yella tifirɣa-ik ɣellin-d, tzemreḍ ad txarreḍ.
